status: declared before any model score; owner (20 Nov): 'Yes' to item 1 of the fixable-parts list (herders / pastoral capacity)
question: Does the model's split between herding and farming (grazing capacity vs cleared crop capacity) match where societies actually relied on herding, and is the grazing level right?

target.data: Ethnographic Atlas via D-PLACE (dplace-dataset-ea, CLDF, CC BY), downloaded 2026-11-20 to data/cache/dplace_ea; not redistributed
target.variables: EA004 dependence on animal husbandry, EA005 dependence on agriculture (10-point bins, bin midpoints 2.5 ... 93 %)
target.domain: societies with both codes inside the Earth run (0-56 N, 12 W - 125 E) on a land cell: 546 at declaration (63 herding-dominant)
target.caveat: ethnographic present (median focal year 1920), not AD 200; the environment-driven herding/farming split is the target, not a dated AD 200 occupation

model.fields: the Earth run (output/land_people/earth/earth.npz, rebuilt 20 Nov; regional totals reproduce within 1.5 %) through harvest.models.settlement_fields exactly as polity.earth.earth_people
model.share: model herding share = k x pastoral_capacity / (crop_capacity x clearance + k x pastoral_capacity), mean over the 3 x 3 cells (15 arc-min) around the society
model.M1: k fitted on dev from {0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 5, 7, 10} by balanced accuracy of herding-dominant (model share > 0.5) vs observed; ties -> k closest to 1

split: 10-degree tiles in a checkerboard: dev = (floor(lat/10) + floor(lon/10)) even (268 societies), blind = odd (278)

scores.rank: Spearman correlation of model share vs observed share (same for any k: k shifts the level, not the ranks)
scores.reported_only: mean model vs observed share by D-PLACE region; level of grazing capacity implied by k

blind_gates.G1: M1 blind BA >= M0 blind BA + 0.05
blind_gates.G2: blind Spearman >= 0.30 (the pattern must carry signal before any level change is adopted)
blind_gates.adopt: G1 and G2: pastoral capacity on the map is scaled by k (feeds food capacity, population and the pasture layers; a rebuild is planned with the owner first). G2 alone: current level kept, pattern reported as supported. G2 fails: grazing pattern flagged as unsupported, next step is its biome forage table.
